crossRefs.note: “But as for me, I would seek God. I would commit my cause to God,
“If you set your heart aright, stretch out your hands toward him.
“Acquaint yourself with him, now, and be at peace. By it, good will come to you.
Lay your treasure in the dust, the gold of Ophir among the stones of the brooks.
When he was in distress, he begged Yahweh his God, and humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers.
He prayed to him; and he was entreated by him, and heard his supplication, and brought him again to Jerusalem into his…
Seek Yahweh while he may be found. Call on him while he is near.
Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts. Let him return to Yahweh, and he will have mercy…
“Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you.
For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.
Therefore, even as the Holy Spirit says, “Today if you will hear his voice,
don’t harden your hearts, as in the rebellion, like as in the day of the trial in the wilderness,
Be subject therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

translations.web: If you want to seek God diligently, make your supplication to the Almighty.
translations.bsb: But if you would earnestly seek God and ask the Almighty for mercy,
translations.kjv: If thou wouldest seek unto God betimes, and make thy supplication to the Almighty;
translations.asv: If thou wouldest seek diligently unto God, And make thy supplication to the Almighty;
